shots.text: The last land was the Hollow Rift, where the war began. The Veilwalkers guard it. Their Warden, Nyxara, sleeps in the dark along its edge.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Hollow Rift at night: violet grass, floating stone steps, and the edge of the chasm.

shots.text: From the edge you can see the Black Gate, miles down, and the gap in it, and a grey line of soldiers still coming out.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Looking down into the Rift: the Gate far below, the cart-wide gap, a thin grey column climbing the road cut into the wall.

shots.text: Nyxara had gone mad, and the Rift could not keep out the forest. Thorns grew over everything, and dead trees walked. Their Herald was Mother Briar, once the Deepwood's best healer.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Black thorns choking the Veilwalker towns; a thicket-woman with grey flowers in her hair walking among them: Mother Briar.

shots.text: The Veilwalkers at Lamplight say some nights a white light moves along the bottom of the Rift. Slowly. Like someone walking with a lantern.
shots.speaker: tamsin
shots.art_note: Tamsin at the Lamplight waystation, looking down into the Rift. Far below, very small, a white light moving.
